Where your progress lives

Everything on this page stays in this browser. Clearing this site’s data, or your browsing data, deletes it. A different browser, a private window or another device starts empty. To keep a copy or to move to another device, use Export and then Import on the other side.

Back up, move or reset

Export saves everything on this page (pages, ticks, notes, opened answers and the last 500 activity entries) as one JSON file. Import reads such a file and merges it with what is here: where both sides have a record for the same page, step or note, the newer one wins, so importing the same file twice changes nothing. Reset deletes everything in this browser.

Delete all your progress in this browser? Every done mark, tick, note and activity entry goes, and it cannot be undone. Export first if you might want it back.

Storage and privacy

  • The tracker uses your browser’s IndexedDB storage, or its local storage when IndexedDB is not available. It uses no cookies, no account and no network.
  • Progress belongs to the address the book was opened from. The book opened from disk and the same book served by tools/serve.py on http://127.0.0.1:8765/ keep separate progress; export from one and import into the other to join them.
  • Chrome and Edge keep progress for pages opened from disk. Firefox and Safari may refuse storage for such pages, or keep each page separately. If ticks do not survive a reload, run python3 tools/serve.py in the book’s folder and open http://127.0.0.1:8765/.
  • If the browser refuses all storage, every page shows a notice saying that progress is not being kept.
